rows.explanation: Time-window decision lacks an explicitly documented study reference date. Converted to UNKNOWN. Original reasoning: The criterion excludes patients who have received any anti-cancer therapy within 4 weeks before the first study dose. The latest chemotherapy (FOLFIRI, Cycle 8) was administered on 2026-03-20. However, the date of the first study dose is not provided, so the time window for the 4 weeks before study-dose cannot be confirmed. Despite the missing first study-dose date, the last known chemotherapy was given on 2026-03-20, which is 10 days before the last record date 2026-03-30, implying treatment likely occurred within 4 weeks before study dose if study dose is near or on 2026-03-30. This indicates potential exclusion by recent anti-cancer therapy. There is no evidence of major surgery within 4 weeks that has not fully healed. Due to missing explicit study-dose date, the status is categorized as DOES_NOT_APPLY because the anti-cancer therapy was last given more than 4 weeks prior only if the study dose is beyond 2026-04-17. But typically given the last therapy on 2026-03-20 and evidence dated 2026-03-30, likely the therapy was within 4 weeks. However, for exclusion, we prefer to mark status based on actual evidence of timing relative to study-dose, which is unknown. As no explicit surgery is reported, the exclusion from major surgery does not apply.
